craft_notes: Sthāyin: manifold-difference — the multiplicity clause. Sanskrit-first: kutra/kadā/kasya indefinites kept bare (somewhere/someone/sometime); āśvāsa-upalabdhi kept as source-ablative ('from assurance-attainment'). Rows: 9 (one-two-threefold + whole/part + somewhere/someone/sometime triple-triple), 5 (graded roll: division, extent, the three indefinites, then the source), 1 (‘manifold’ closes — vicitra end-weight). Close: 'difference is manifold.' Rejected: 'various' — killed: vicitra is manifold-of-differences (bheda-adjacent); dropping the indefinites for rhythm — killed: the three bare words ARE the manifoldness. Read aloud: THERE-in-TOO — BY-one-, TWO-, THREE-fold-DI-vi-SION, WHOLE or-PART; SOME-where, FOR-SOME-one, SOME-time, AND-so FROM-AS-surance-AT-tain-ment: DIFF-er-ence IS-man-i-FOLD.

lines: Therein too — by one-, two-, threefold division,
whole or part; somewhere, for someone, sometime,
and so from assurance-attainment: difference is manifold.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi ca ekadvitryādibhedena samastavyastatayā kvacit kasyacit kadācit ca tathā āśvāsopalabdheḥ vicitro bhedaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How manifold is difference? → Bheda is vicitra by construction: division-grade, extent, locus, person, time all vary, and the manifoldness itself proceeds from assurance-attainment (āśvāsa-upalabdhi).
c1_essence: Difference is manifold — by one-two-threefold division, whole or part, somewhere, for someone, sometime, from assurance-attainment.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)
